name: 峻岭公寓历史高层主楼（锦江饭店中楼）
address: 茂名南路65－125号（名录范围；地方志主楼门牌59号，门牌对应未核）

documentary_sources.title: 《上海名建筑志》现代艺术派风格的峻岭公寓大楼（锦江饭店中楼）
documentary_sources.authority: 上海市地方志办公室公开地方志章节
claims: 茂名南路59号，1934年建成，1935年出租。
峻岭寄庐、峻岭公寓、高纳公寓等名；1956年改名茂名公寓，后为锦江饭店中楼。
建筑面积23985平方米，平面呈五折环形、略带弧状；中央18层包括地下1层，东西对称16、15、14、13层阶梯跌落；高78米。
公和洋行和爱尔德打样行设计，友联建造公司承造，另有鹤记营造厂施工一说。
棕色面砖、门口部分大理石，垂直线条分为中东西三部分；屋顶有花园和阳台。
主楼西边另有6幢3层公寓，总建筑面积约1万平方米。

photos.file: 锦江饭店·峻岭公寓·上海.jpg
photos.author: Legolas1024
photos.view: Elevated view from the southwestern garden side toward the long main elevation; visible stepped terraces and the forecourt.
features: Tall central tower has narrow continuous pale vertical ribs and a stepped pale top screen/crown; darker narrow slots separate the uppermost fins.
Both wings descend in several steps. Broad horizontal window rows contrast with the center and end-pier vertical ribs. The overall wall bends/folds around the garden.
Warm brown/ochre face, dark or grey-green multi-pane windows, pale top parapets and return lines; materials and colors are observed appearance, not laboratory samples.
Some upper terraces show railings, small shelters/planting and equipment; a geometric glazed entrance canopy projects at the central base.
Low connected blocks and covered links lie outside the principal tall wings. A separate much taller cylindrical-top building stands behind and must not be merged into this subject.
limits: Does not reveal full opposite rear face or a complete measured roof/perimeter plan.
Aerial perspective and cropped/obscured base prevent measured floor heights, exact window spacing or a certified number of above-ground floors.
EXIF altitude is not used: file metadata reports an implausible below-sea-level value for this elevated view.
Main crown, terrace surfaces and antenna/equipment positions are approximate photographic observations, not measured dimensions.
photos.review_method: Actual functions tools.view_image of each downloaded local JPEG by cathay_reference on2026-10-31

photos.author: Livelikerw
photos.view: Street/gate-side oblique view, described by the file page as from the Jinjiang Hotel main entrance; shows one tall wing behind lower brick frontage.
features: The tall wing has narrow pale vertical ribs, brown piers and repeated grey-green windows.
Foreground low brick frontage has its own roof line, wider multi-pane openings, balcony details and a corner/stair element; it is not the high-rise silhouette.
Trees obscure the right and upper areas; this photograph helps separate a low attached/adjoining component from the principal tower.
limits: Not a complete low-building survey or proof that the foreground contains all six apartments described in the gazetteer.
Does not establish legal listed-place boundaries or whether every connected low block shares the high-rise heritage extent.
No complete opposite rear elevation or exact roof depths.

photos.author: 乔茗星
photos.view: More distant oblique view of the principal stepped tower and wings; precise geographic camera orientation was not independently established.
features: The stepped central pale crown, vertical-ribbed center and both cascading wings corroborate Grosvenor’s identity and overall silhouette.
Long horizontal window rows follow the folded/curved-looking wall; the end portions again show vertical emphasis.
Nearby low roofs partly hide the base.
limits: File caption calls this 锦北楼, conflicting with the authoritative Cathay/Grosvenor distinction. The caption’s north-building alias is rejected; identification follows the distinctive visible Grosvenor form and the authoritative chapter.
Strong color/saturation and blur treatment make this unsuitable for material color calibration or exact small-detail counts.
